name: Allyson Lehrer
office: Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Allyson Lehrer has worked in middle school, high school, higher education, and arts nonprofits. She is vice chair of the district’s Education Advisory Committee and a PTA second vice president. Her priorities include financial stewardship, safe schools, preparing students, and enrollment. She supports age-appropriate technology guardrails. She wants to limit screens for students under first grade when not needed for adaptive purposes. She wants to use data to understand enrollment trends and communicate district strengths.

sentences.text: Allyson Lehrer has worked in middle school, high school, higher education, and arts nonprofits.
She is vice chair of the district’s Education Advisory Committee and a PTA second vice president.
Her priorities include financial stewardship, safe schools, preparing students, and enrollment.
She wants to limit screens for students under first grade when not needed for adaptive purposes.
She wants to use data to understand enrollment trends and communicate district strengths.

items.text: Lehrer opposes expansive voucher programs that divert public funds to private school tuition. She supports clear accountability for the $297.8 million Measure SOS bond in priorities, timelines, budgets, and maintenance. She wants to explore operational efficiencies, philanthropy, grants, and partnerships to complement educators' compensation.
